questions.subject: MICROECONOMICS
questions.topic: Why truth-telling weakly dominates in a second-price auction
questions.stem: Explain why bidding your value weakly dominates other bids in a second-price auction.

answer.exemplar: Truth-telling never yields lower payoff than any other bid and sometimes yields strictly higher, since payment is set by others' bids.

questions.explanation: If you win, you pay the second price regardless of your bid above it; shading risks losing profitable auctions. Truth-telling is safe.
questions.hint: Payment is the second price, not yours.
